note: First version: the small spinner a header shows while its screen's data loads, which layouts wrote as a core://Conditional around a core://Progress

component.doc: A small spinner shown only while the screen's data loads (local://screen#loading), and nothing otherwise: among a header's actions or beside its title, so a pushed screen says it is still fetching. 16 dp across by default. core:page_header draws one itself with loading.

examples.note: at the end of a pushed screen's header, while its post loads
beside a settings screen's title, a little larger
